from: NOTE FOR THE TESTER: of those three statuses only Paid exists in the data on this test system, so check it on a Paid work order and mark the case Blocked saying so — do not pass it on Paid alone. (Two statuses this case used to name, “Declined” and “Imported”, are not statuses this product has at all; the list is Estimate, Approved, In progress, Review, Complete, Invoiced, Paid.)
to: NOTE FOR THE TESTER: all three of these statuses exist on the test system, so check all three. The full list of work order statuses is Estimate, Approved, In progress, Review, Declined, Complete, Invoiced and Paid — “Declined” is a real status and the button is shown on it, while “Imported” is not a status this product has.
